title: Pixly SMP
description: A free SMP server powered by Pixly Hosting. Java and Bedrock crossplay, any version from 1.8 to the latest — no extra accounts, no version lock. Open to everyone.
body:
# Pixly SMP

A **free SMP server powered by [Pixly Hosting](https://pixly.gg)**.
One survival world, open to everyone — whatever device or version you play on.

## Who can join
- 🎮 **Java + Bedrock crossplay** — PC, console, mobile, or Win10, same world.
- 🔢 **Any version, 1.8 → latest** — connect on the client you already have.
- 🚪 **No hoops** — Bedrock players don't need a Java account. Just connect.

## What's on the server
- 🛡️  **Land claims** to protect your base from griefers.
- ⏪ **Full grief rollback** — nothing is permanently lost.

[Online Map](https://pixly-az0rc7pv.pixly.gg/)

## Reliable by default
- ⚡ Dedicated hardware — no shared compute, no lag spikes.
- 💾 Automated daily backups.

Free to play. Bring your friends. ⛏️
